slide_10.formula_scope: J_b is one component of the inner route heuristic. The whole teacher uses lexicographic native outcome ranks and finite policy continuations.

slide_10.interpretation: Finite policy portfolio and horizon, with complete-game qualification and separate zero-loss positive continuation admission before student distillation. No global optimality, universal safety or trained-v4 claim.
